structuralLabelCheck.rule: Standalone bold lines and hash headings are section boundaries. import-markdown.ts matches /^\*{2,3}\s*(.+?)\s*\*{2,3}$/ and treats the result as a level-3 heading.

findings.diagnosis: This block is a reference card, and the baseline writes it in a plainer register than the chapter it summarizes: contractions, find each other, the system's job. That difference is the point of a reference section, which is meant to be scanned rather than read. Stop being structurally invisible names a change of state that the declarations cause; are no longer structurally invisible reports a condition. And the semicolon in not one-time; they're refreshed keeps the correction attached to the claim it corrects, where a full stop makes it a new fact.

regenerationTest.conclusion: No new rule required. The useful observation is about the damage report rather than the prose: a section reported at minus 95 percent turned out to have lost almost nothing, because the pass promoted five inline labels to headings and the measurement followed the boundary rather than the words. A large negative delta is a reason to look, not a finding.
